create_task_from_config: create a PyText task from a config object using the create_task factory function
build_task_from_config: build a TaskBase instance from config by wiring up data handler, model, trainer, and exporter
train_model: train a PyText model using the task trainer with train and eval data iterators
test_model_on_holdout: test a PyText model on a holdout dataset and compute evaluation metrics
predict_on_examples: generate predictions on unlabeled JSON examples using the PyText task model
